title: OpenAirInterface CN5G SMF through 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in…
description: OpenAirInterface CN5G SMF versions up to 2.2.2 have a vulnerability in the function handle_pdu_session_release_sm_context_request() where N7 SM policy associations at the PCF are not properly deleted. Authenticated user equipment (UEs) can exploit this by repeatedly establishing and releasing PDU sessions, causing stale associations to accumulate and potentially exhausting PCF memory.
